body_excerpt:
On October 12, 2026, we released versions 19.4.2, 19.3.5, 19.2.8 for GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE).

19.3.4 had a bug that affected merge request pages when the Ona integration was enabled. This is fixed in 19.3.5.

These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated customers do not need to take action.

GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases. There are two types of patch releases: scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities. Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays. For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ. You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here.

For security fixes, the issues detailing each vulnerability are made public on our issue tracker 90 days after the release in which they were patched.

We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to the highest security standards. To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version. You can read more best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post.

Recommended Action

We strongly recommend that all installations running a version affected by the issues described below are upgraded to the latest version as soon as possible.

When no specific deployment type (omnibus, source code, helm chart, etc.) of a product is mentioned, it means all types are affected.

CVE-2026-97229 - Integer Overflow issue in CI/CD Regular Expression Compiler impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 10.0 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H)

Thanks joaxcar for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-92883 - Cross-site Scripting issue in syntax highlighting impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of other users’ browser sessions via a specially crafted repository, due to improper sanitization of HTML attributes in syntax-highlighted output.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 8.7 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N)

Thanks a0xnirudh for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-16301 - Improper Authorization issue in downstream pipeline creation service impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with Developer role to execute CI/CD pipelines on protected branches without authorization due to improper authorization checks in the downstream pipeline creation service.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 18.7 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 8.5 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:H/A:N)

Thanks sim4n6 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-14814 - Permissive Regular Expression issue in repository file access impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed a user to poison cached responses for raw repository files, causing targeted users’ CI/CD pipelines to execute specially crafted content and potentially exposing protected environment variables, due to improper validation of repository references.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 8.2 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N)

Thanks ahacker1 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-81839 - Incorrect Authorization issue in scheduled pipeline execution policy impacts GitLab EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to execute arbitrary CI/CD pipelines in a transferred project with the new group’s privileges due to improper cleanup of scheduled pipeline execution policy records.

Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 18.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 7.7 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N)

Thanks no_01 for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-96893 - Improper Neutralization of Input Used for LLM Prompting issue in GitLab Duo Agent Platform impacts GitLab EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to inject specially crafted content into AI agent instructions, potentially causing unintended command execution attributed to other users, due to improper neutralization of special elements in AI conversation context construction.

Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 7.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N)

This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Mert Coskuner.

CVE-2026-101168 - Sensitive Information Exposure issue in GitLab Pages impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with access to GitLab Pages log data to obtain access tokens and other secrets, due to insertion of sensitive request data into log files and error tracking events.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 12.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 6.2 (CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N)

This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member RJ Coleman.

CVE-2026-7767 - Open Redirect issue in Kubernetes proxy impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user controlling a Kubernetes agent to cause sensitive authentication tokens to be sent to an unintended server due to improper redirect validation in the Kubernetes proxy.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 13.11 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 5.8 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N)

Thanks joaxcar for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-16275 - Incorrect Authorization issue in GraphQL notes widget impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read confidential notes on public projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 17.4 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 5.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

Thanks jaykp for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-84284 - Incorrect Authorization issue in GraphQL work item hierarchy impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read work item contents from private groups and projects due to incorrect authorization checks.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 17.11 before 19.2.8, all 19.3 versions, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 5.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

Thanks modhanami for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-85529 - Incorrect Authorization issue in GraphQL scope impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to read internal notes and confidential system notes on public projects due to improper authorization in the GraphQL API.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 5.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

Thanks silaen_space for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-100755 - Page cache poisoning via improper cache key construction in merge requests impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain deployment configurations, could have allowed an authenticated user to poison cached page content served to other users due to improper cache key construction.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 16.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.6 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L)

This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Peter Arts.

CVE-2026-14552 - Incorrect Authorization issue in work items GraphQL API impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with Guest access to read confidential epic content meant to be restricted by external authorization, due to incorrect authorization checks.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 17.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

Thanks 3nvz for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-6567 - Missing Authorization issue in merge request accessibility report comparison endpoint impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with reporter role to access restricted CI artifact report content they were not authorized to, due to missing authorization checks.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 13.8 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N)

Thanks se1en for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-104661 - Incorrect Privilege Assignment issue in custom roles impacts GitLab EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a custom role with compliance framework administration permissions to configure and execute a specially crafted compliance pipeline across group projects due to improper privilege assignment.

Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 17.0 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N)

This vulnerability has been discovered internally by a GitLab team member.

CVE-2026-14210 - Insufficient Granularity of Access Control issue in project label management impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user with a project-scoped fine-grained Personal Access Token to permanently delete or modify group-level labels, due to incorrect authorization logic on label ownership scope validation.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 18.11 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N)

Thanks bate5a for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-105458 - Governance Control Bypass issue in Duo Agent Platform impacts GitLab EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user holding a specific granular permission to obtain a GitLab Duo Agent Platform token that bypasses governance controls, due to reliance on untrusted input in a security decision.

Impacted Versions: GitLab EE: all versions from 19.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.3 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N)

This vulnerability has been discovered internally by GitLab team member Rahul Barnwal.

CVE-2026-5954 - Incorrect Authorization issue in package registry impacts GitLab CE/EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed a user to download package files from a public project due to improper authorization checks.

Impacted Versions: GitLab CE/EE: all versions from 15.1 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4 before 19.4.2
CVSS 4.2 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N)

Thanks rogerace for reporting this vulnerability through our HackerOne bug bounty program.

CVE-2026-92528 - Incorrect Authorization issue in merge request approval eligibility check impacts GitLab EE

GitLab has remediated an issue that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an authenticated user to approve a merge request despite having contributed commits to it, due to improper identity resolution.
